Frequently Asked Questions on News SEO

News SEO is a specialized approach to optimizing news content for search engines, particularly Google News and Top Stories. It’s crucial for publishers because it helps news articles gain immediate visibility during breaking news events, increases traffic from Google Discover, and ensures content appears in news-specific search features where competition is based on freshness and authority rather than just traditional ranking factors.

Google News no longer requires manual approval. Focus on meeting technical requirements: unique URLs, clear timestamps, proper HTML markup, and consistent publication of original news content. Implement NewsArticle structured data, submit a news sitemap through Google Publisher Center, ensure fast page speeds, and maintain a clear section structure with transparent authorship information.

Key practices include publishing content quickly with accurate timestamps, using descriptive headlines that include relevant keywords, implementing proper NewsArticle schema markup, maintaining mobile-friendly pages with fast load times, updating articles as stories develop, and building topical authority through consistent coverage. Also focus on creating compelling meta descriptions and using clear URL structures.
